hypothesis.statement: A non-empty morph inventory does not prove that the assistant can blink asymmetrically, open its jaw, articulate required visemes, or drive facial expressions.
hypothesis.action: Collect the actual presentation DataAsset in UE 5.6, classify every binding as a direct morph or explicitly acknowledged Control Rig curve, and verify required semantics against the P33 morph inventory.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Missing or ambiguous facial actuation fails closed before deformation QA while Looking Glass Go presentation lineage remains fixed.

scopeBoundary: Control Rig curves are not falsely required to appear as SkeletalMesh morph target names
coverage does not prove deformation quality, lip sync, identity, skin, eyes, hair or runtime performance
P12 frame-level deformation evidence and real Looking Glass Go captures remain mandatory
failureHandling: reject missing required semantic or invalid scale
reject duplicate mappings or shared left/right blink curve
reject direct morph absent from P33 inventory
reject Control Rig curve without explicit animation-bridge acknowledgement
reject any production, deformation or automatic-approval overclaim
decision: Use a verified mapping only as the input to expression and deformation capture; never treat semantic coverage as AAA approval.
